worldcombat.skill.healingwish.summary: Gives itself away: the user faints on the spot and leaves a wish star where it fell. The star waits; the first wounded or afflicted ally to come to it is restored by a share of its maximum health and has every harmful status effect cleared; with no one in need it fades on its own. With no ally able to receive, the user does not faint.
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.use.0: Trade your life for a large heal on an ally
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.use.1: Leave a wish for a brawling ally before you die
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.use.2: Turn your fall spot into a rescue point
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.descriptio: The user falls on the spot and leaves a healing wish where it fell; the first wounded or afflicted ally to enter %2$s blocks is restored by %1$s of its maximum health (up to its missing health) and has every harmful status effect cleared. With no ally able to receive it, the move cannot be used and the user does not fall.
The wish waits about %1$s s; the first wounded or afflicted ally to reach it consumes it, and if no one needs it the wish fades on its own.
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.stance.bro: Broad wish: x1.4 radius and a shorter wait, but only x0.7 healing (wide and shallow).
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.stance.foc: Focused wish: x0.85 radius and a longer wait, but full healing (close, one ally made whole).
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP and the user falls, then it recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast. It cannot move while preparing and can be interrupted (and then does not fall).
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 1 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 3 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
worldcombat.skill.healingwish.preference: On: x1.4 radius and x0.85 wait, but only x0.7 healing. Off (focused wish): x0.85 radius, x1.2 wait and full healing. Each direction has its moments.
The companion gives up its life only when below this ratio with an ally in need nearby; lower endures longer, higher wishes at the first low health.
An ally within this distance is worth wishing for; lower sacrifices only when adjacent, higher leaves a wish for allies further out.
world_combat.move.healingwish.text.waste: No one to receive; the wish was not left
